scope: deployment hardening only: export, runtime integration, parity, hardening, performance, playground. No training, no re-training, no seed change, no architecture/tokenizer/vocabulary/annotation/taxonomy change, no compression/distillation/layer sharing/pruning/QAT, no new data, no threshold change, no special-casing of any note. gidi-finance-v1 is not modified.
architecture: accepted value-span-v7-dual-encoder: path A = frozen gidi-finance-v1 (compression-v3 4x768 student, FFN 2048, 34 position rows, vocabulary B-rank-8000) encoder + type head + target BIO head, the only source of type and target; path B = independently fine-tuned copy of the v1 encoder -> Dropout -> Linear(768,256) -> GELU -> Dropout -> Linear(256,3) emissions -> linear-chain CRF (learned start/end/transition scores) -> Viterbi, the only source of the value span. Both paths consume the same input_ids/attention_mask from one tokenization. One ONNX graph, inputs input_ids/attention_mask, outputs type_logits/tag_logits/value_logits (CRF emissions); CRF scores and Viterbi decoding live in the bundle config and the numpy runtime. max_length 32, ONNX INT8 dynamic (QInt8 weights) exactly as v1.

seed_selection.rule: value-head seed 1, the export_seed declared in experiments/value-span-v7-dual-encoder/protocol.json before training; path A is the gidi-finance-v1 seed-1 checkpoint
seed_selection.why_not_held_out_metrics: selecting the value-head seed by test/probe results would select on evaluation sets and bias every later number reported for the deployed model

value_decoding_rule: tags = CRF Viterbi path over the real (non-special) tokens, special tokens O; spans by the target-head BIO rule (B starts, I extends or starts after O, O/B ends; whitespace-trimmed offsets); the value span is the span with the highest value_confidence (ties to the earlier span); value_confidence = geometric mean over the span's tokens of softmax(value_logits) of the Viterbi tag, or with no span the minimum softmax P(O) over the real tokens. This is exactly gidi.modeling.value_decode.decode_value(..., crf=...) used for every v7 metric.
golden_suite_source: approved annotation-v2 records outside test and probe-v1 (training-v1 train/validation). Expected outputs are the PyTorch reference predictions of the source checkpoint decoded by the rule above; human labels are stored alongside for information. The suite checks runtime correctness, not model quality.
evaluation_sets_report_only: datasets/annotation-v2/training-v1 test (test-v1 + test-targeted) and probe-v1: used only to report parity and INT8 quality, never to select, tune or special-case
thresholds: none; confidences are uncalibrated scores, abstention policy is left to a later calibration phase
acceptance_gate: bundle reproducible from the sources (freeze_deployment --check byte-identical); every bundle file matches manifest.json
bundle tokenizer encodes identically to the training tokenizer

PyTorch vs ONNX FP32 on golden suite, test, probe and robustness inputs: 0 mismatches in type, target BIO tags, target span, value Viterbi tags and value span; max abs logit difference and max confidence difference reported for each output

path A invariance: v2 FP32 type/target outputs equal the v1 PyTorch model, and v2 INT8 type/target predictions and spans equal the gidi-finance-v1 bundle on golden suite, test, probe and robustness inputs (0 mismatches)

ONNX INT8 vs ONNX FP32: golden suite 0 differences in type, target span and value span; on test and probe each field agrees on >= 99% of notes, every disagreement is listed, and INT8 value metrics still meet the frozen value-span-v7 criteria (test exact >= 0.95, human-only >= 0.90, present/null >= 0.97, multi_number >= 0.90, every slice with n >= 5 >= 0.80)
runtime output equals the PyTorch reference decode for FP32
offsets slice the caller's original string; truncated is true exactly when the note exceeds max_length; confidences are finite; null states serialize; robustness inputs never crash
runtime reads only the bundle directory and imports only numpy, onnxruntime and tokenizers
INT8 model size, bundle size and CPU latency measured and reported (no size threshold)
on_gate_failure: stop and report the blocker; no retraining, no seed change, no change to the v7 experiment
